en.name: Membrillo
en.summary: Membrillo is quince cooked with roughly its own weight in sugar and reduced until it sets solid enough to slice. Unopened it keeps about 6–18 months in the cupboard from purchase. Once cut, wrap the face and refrigerate it, where about 6–12 months is the range.
en.pantry: Unopened, keep the block in a cool dark cupboard for about 6–18 months from purchase. It is a very high sugar, high acid, low water preserve, which is exactly why it keeps — the numbers here are borrowed from jams and preserves, and if anything membrillo sits at the long end of that family because it is drier. Sugar crystals appearing on the surface with age are a texture fault, not spoilage. Keep it away from the hob and out of the sun so it does not slump.
en.fridge: Once the block is cut, wrap the cut face in film or greaseproof paper and refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where about 6–12 months is the range. It will sweat a little in the cold and may weep a syrupy film — blot it with kitchen paper rather than rinsing it. Cut slices with a wet knife, which stops the paste dragging. Mould on the cut face means the block goes: unlike a hard cheese, a soft paste is colonised right through and cannot be trimmed back.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for membrillo and there is no need for one: it is already about as stable as a fruit preserve gets, and the fridge gives it months. Freezing a dense sugar paste also does very little, since the sugar keeps it from freezing hard, and thawing brings condensation onto the cut face — the one thing that starts mould. Wrap it well and keep it cold instead.
spoilage: Mould anywhere on the block, particularly on the cut face
A fermented or alcoholic smell rather than a sweet, floral, faintly tannic one
A wet, slimy or sticky surface that does not blot dry
The block slumping into a soft paste that will no longer hold a slice
tips: Wrap the cut face tightly; an exposed face dries and then moulds.
Use a wet knife to cut clean slices.
Blot any syrupy weeping rather than rinsing it.
Buy a small block if you serve it only with cheese occasionally.

faq.q: How long does membrillo last once opened?
faq.a: About 6–12 months refrigerated with the cut face wrapped. That range is borrowed from jams and preserves.

faq.q: Does membrillo need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while sealed — about 6–18 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once cut, wrap it and refrigerate it.

faq.q: Is the sugary crust on old membrillo a problem?
faq.a: No. Sugar crystallising on the surface with age is a texture fault, not spoilage.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off membrillo?
faq.a: No. A soft paste is colonised all the way through, unlike a hard cheese. Discard the block.

zh.name: 榲桲果糕
zh.summary: Membrillo 是把榲桲和幾乎等重的糖一起熬煮、收乾到可以切片的固體果糕。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6～18 個月。切開之後把切面包好冷藏，大約 6～12 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封請放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6～18 個月。它是超高糖、高酸、低水分的果類保存品，這正是它耐放的原因——這裡的數字借自果醬與蜜餞醬，而 membrillo 因為更乾，如果有差別的話也是落在較長的那一端。放久後表面出現糖結晶是質地問題，不是腐壞。請遠離爐火、避免日曬，以免整塊塌軟。
zh.fridge: 切開之後，切面用保鮮膜或烘焙紙包緊，放 4 °C 以下冷藏，大約 6～12 個月。低溫下它會微微出汗，也可能滲出一層糖漿膜——用廚房紙巾吸掉即可，不要用水沖。切片時把刀沾濕，才不會黏刀拖爛。切面長霉就整塊丟掉：和硬質乳酪不同，柔軟的果糕會被整塊佔領，切掉表層並沒有用。
zh.freezer: Membrillo 沒有冷凍期限，也不需要：它本來就是水果保存品裡數一數二穩定的，冷藏又能放好幾個月。冷凍一塊高糖果糕效果也有限，因為糖讓它凍不硬，而解凍時切面會結冷凝水——那正是發霉的起點。與其冷凍，不如包好冰著。
spoilage: 整塊任何地方長霉，尤其是切面
聞起來有發酵味或酒味，而不是甜香帶花香、微微澀感
整塊塌成軟糊，已經切不成片
tips: 切面一定要包緊；裸露的切面會先乾掉再發霉。
用沾濕的刀才切得出乾淨的切片。
滲出的糖漿用紙巾吸掉，不要用水沖。
只偶爾配乳酪吃的話，買小塊就好。

faq.q: Membrillo 切開後可以放多久？
faq.a: 切面包好冷藏大約 6～12 個月。這個範圍借自果醬與蜜餞醬。
未開封不用，陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 6～18 個月。切開後就要包好冷藏。

faq.q: 表面那層糖霜有問題嗎？
faq.a: 沒有。放久後糖結晶到表面是質地問題，不是腐壞。
不行。柔軟的果糕會被霉整塊滲透，和硬質乳酪不同。整塊丟掉。
